topic: Which of these joined the United Nations most recently? (South Sudan, 14 July 2011; Montenegro 28 June 2006; Switzerland 10 September 2002)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

claims.text: South Sudan is the most recent UN member: admitted 14 July 2011 as the 193rd member, five days after independence on 9 July 2011.
vo: which of these joined the united nations most recently
south sudan. it became member number 193 on 14 july 2011, just days after independence

claims.text: Montenegro was admitted to the UN on 28 June 2006, after its independence referendum of 21 May 2006.
vo: montenegro joined in june 2006, just a month after its own independence vote

claims.text: Switzerland, neutral since 1815, joined the UN only on 10 September 2002 after a referendum on 3 March 2002.
vo: and switzerland, neutral since 1815, only joined the un in 2002, after a nationwide referendum

claims.text: The UN has 193 member states today (51 in 1945); no state has been admitted since South Sudan in 2011.
vo: 193 members today, and nobody at all has joined since south sudan
